## Type of change
- feat: new functionality
- fix: a bug fix
- refactor: code restructured, behavior the same
- perf: faster or lighter, behavior the same
- test: tests only
- docs: documentation only
- chore: maintenance, such as tooling, templates, workflow or dependencies
